messages:
ci-bot: build #42568 — PR 2409 merge-preview — FAILED on ubuntu-20.04 (linux-amd64). test //runtime/tests:serve_timer_flicker_test failed (exit code 1). logs: https://ci.internal/42568

jess: CI red on serve_timer_flicker_test in PR 2409 — failing in the merge preview pipeline. quick check?

sam: can someone rerun the job? I'll kick it if nobody else can.

ci-bot: rerun requested by @sam — started job #42569

ci-bot: job #42569 — FAILED again, same test, same assertion.

jess: failing snippet from the log: 
```
E serve_timer_flicker_test.cpp:142: Assertion failed: elapsed_ms <= 10 (got 28)
   at runtime::Timer::sleep_for(Timer.cpp:118)
   at tests::ServeTimerFlickerTest::RunTest(serve_timer_flicker_test.cpp:96)
```

kai: that looks like a timing-variance failure. Any seed printed? reproducible locally?

jess: log shows seed=498321. local repro command I used: 
```bash
bazel test //runtime/tests:serve_timer_flicker_test --test_arg=--seed=498321 --runs_per_test=20
```
I can repro 1/30 on my laptop with that.

marco: I'll spin up a noisy box and run a stress loop. also can bisect the commit range if needed.

anya: FYI this started popping up after the timer jitter refactor in recent commits (2406-2408), maybe related.

sam: short mitigation: add test tolerance (bump 10ms -> 100ms) and mark flaky to unblock CI? quick PR possible.

jess: I'd prefer we bisect first to avoid masking a real bug. but if this blocks a release, quick patch + revert is ok.

marco: bisect started: testing commits 2400..2415 (parallel). will report the commit that flips.

marco: update: narrowed to 2407 (timer jitter refactor). on ec2-c6i devbox with --runs_per_test=200 I see 1/60 failures. seed differs but pattern consistent.

kai: sounds like nondeterministic jitter interacting with reduced sleep granularity on CI. suggestion: stub RNG in test or inject deterministic jitter for unit tests.

jess: agreed. opened issue INFR-789 to track making jitter deterministic in tests and a draft PR that stubs the rng for ServeTimerFlickerTest. tagging @marco for bisect artifacts.

marco: bisect artifacts: https://ci.internal/bisect/3177777000 — shows culprit patch touches random jitter distribution and changes the sleep clamping.

anja: (typo) meant @anya — but yep +1 to deterministic seed in test harness.

sam: for immediate relief I'm going to open a tiny PR that wraps the expectation with a retry helper (3 attempts) and add test to flaky list so other PRs can land. I'll link it here.

jess: OK do that as a stopgap and please add a note to revert once INFR-789 is done. created tests/flaky/serve_timer_flicker_test entry.

marco: opening PR to add a small clamp on jitter when running under CI and a feature-flag to keep production behavior. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/2418 — includes bisect notes.

jess: thanks everyone. plan: (1) apply short-lived fix (sam) to stabilize CI, (2) merge marco's clamp PR behind feature flag, (3) land deterministic-test PR for full fix (INFR-789). monitoring CI for next 24h. :eyes:

sam: noted. will watch and revert quick fix once the deterministic test stub lands. :+1:

ci-bot: test flakiness label applied to //runtime/tests:serve_timer_flicker_test (tests/flaky).

jess: leaving a follow-up task on the board to add a reproducible stress target to our CI perf pool so these timing flakes are caught earlier.

marco: final note — if anyone needs the full bisect logs DM me, I left a summary in the bisect artifact page.

jess: thanks team — closing thread for now, will reopen if fresh failures appear.
